message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Quantity |
|------------|----------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ teaspoons |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ teaspoons |
| Salt | 1 teaspoon |
| Eggs | 2 large |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) |
| Vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) |

**Optional extras** (for richer flavor or texture):
- 1 cup sour cream or plain yogurt (replaces some of the milk)
- ½ cup buttermilk (replaces some of the milk)
- ¼ cup coffee (enhances chocolate flavor)

These amounts will give you a moist, fluffy chocolate cake that’s perfect for frosting or serving as is. Happy baking!
